slides.texte_overlay:
How to become someone
your younger self would admire
Be strong, physically and mentally. Every kid admires strength. Train your body, stay calm under pressure and protect the people you love.
Keep your sense of adventure. Remember how you wanted to explore everything? Travel, try new things, stay curious about the world.
Be kind to people who are struggling. Your younger self knew what it felt like to be left out. Be the one who includes others. Start now.
Do what you said you'd do when you grew up. Learn the instrument, see the country, build the thing. It's not too late. Write the list and start with one.
Keep learning like a kid. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and it brings back the curiosity I had when I was young.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. It brings back the curiosity I had when I was young.

slides.texte_overlay: Have principles you don't trade. Honesty, loyalty, courage. Your younger self believed in them before life made them complicated.
Have fun. Laugh a lot, play sports, joke with friends. Becoming an adult doesn't mean becoming boring. Keep a bit of the kid you were alive and let yourself enjoy things.
